name: Masoud Pezeshkian
role: President of Iran (2024-present); former cardiac surgeon, health minister (2001-2005) and MP for Tabriz
summary: Pezeshkian is a reformist-aligned Iranian politician who campaigned on easing hijab enforcement, lifting internet filtering, reviving nuclear diplomacy and sanctions relief, and respecting ethnic minorities, while pledging loyalty to the Supreme Leader. As president he has pursued negotiation with the West, defended Iran's enrichment right while denying any aim of nuclear weapons, and condemned Israel's actions in Gaza. Many of his domestic pledges have stalled against the limits of his office.

internet-shutdowns.rationale: Wikipedia reports he defended the 2019 internet blackout in a 2024 campaign debate (secondhand, not verified in a transcript). This sits against his pledges to lift filtering, which is a different measure from a shutdown.

women-must-cover.rationale: In 2024 he opposed morality-police enforcement of hijab and said in March 2025 that he cannot enforce the hijab and chastity law because it creates problems for people. He has not called for abolishing the dress requirement itself, so this is mild disagreement with legal enforcement.

minority-language-support.rationale: He has repeatedly advocated implementing Article 15 (ethnic languages in media and literature teaching in schools) and led a Turkic-speakers' Majlis faction. His government's representative opposed an optional ethnic-literature motion in Feb 2025, so the record is mixed.

single-official-language.rationale: He supports Persian as the common language under Article 15 but wants ethnic languages used in media and their literature taught in schools, rather than Persian alone.

reduce-immigration.rationale: In June 2024 he said he would completely seal the border against Afghan migration, organise those already present and seek European acceptance of some refugees.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: At the UN in 2024 he proposed a referendum of all Palestinians, in Palestine and in the diaspora, leading to Muslims, Christians and Jews living in one land free of apartheid, and condemned the Israeli state's conduct. He did not explicitly deny a Jewish state a right to exist in these words.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: In his 2024 UN speech he described Palestinians as victims of four generations of Israeli crimes and colonialism and of seven decades of occupation.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: He has said repeatedly, including at the UN in 2025 and in 2024-25 statements, that Iran has never sought and will never seek a nuclear bomb.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: No stated position in his own words on arming insurgents; the Axis of Resistance label is not his statement.

women-suffrage.rationale: As president he appointed two women vice presidents, a woman minister nominee and a woman spokesperson, having promised this in the campaign. No statement on voting rights as such.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: In his 2024 UN speech he said the prophets' mission was truth and justice for all people regardless of colour, race, gender or language, and that peace requires upholding the rights of all individuals.

clerical-rule.rationale: No stated position on clerical rule as a principle; loyalty to the Supreme Leader in his office is something nearby.

national-self-determination.rationale: At the UN in 2024 he said the only path to end the conflict is to restore the right of all Palestinians to self-determination.

disputed-territory-plebiscite.rationale: He proposed at the UN in 2024 that all Palestinians, those in Palestine and those in the diaspora, decide their future in a referendum.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: No stated position on bases on Iranian territory; remarks on extra-regional powers in the region are something nearby.

no-business-privileges.rationale: In May 2026 he called for transparency and a joint effort against rent-seeking and corruption in the economy. He did not address legal privileges for firms by name.

party-controls-media.rationale: He campaigned in 2024 to remove internet filtering ('I will remove internet filtering') and reaffirmed it in October 2024. As president he ordered action on VPN sales, and in Dec 2025 said he could not lift filtering by order, so the record is mixed.

notes: Positions of the Supreme Leader, the Supreme National Security Council and the system are not counted as his. He did not state views on most economic, social and moral statements in sources reachable here; Persian-language Majlis speeches and president.ir texts were not retrieved. The UN GA 2024 and 2025 texts are partly known through reports (2025 via China Daily). Hijab and internet pledges conflict with his later record of limited action.
